mechanics.claim: Ability goes on cooldown at the end of the first dash, not on initial cast, and this cooldown cannot be reduced while the mark is active.
mechanics.quote: ''Jousting'' will go on cooldown at the end of its first dash, but its cooldown cannot be reduced by cooldown refunding effects such as {{ri|Transcendence}} while its mark is active.

mechanics.claim: Both the initial cast and the recast are separate on-cast activations, triggering on-cast effects independently (e.g. Spellblade).
mechanics.quote: Both casts count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.

mechanics.claim: The pass-through damage does not trigger on-hit effects.
The damage instance applies to all four dash passes (first dash + recast dash, each counted separately) and can strike an enemy champion once per dash pass.
Casting the ultimate during Jousting does not interrupt the dash, so the E dash damage still lands.
mechanics.quote: Casting {{ai|Chaaaaaaaarge!!!|Kled}} during ''Jousting'' will not interrupt the dash.
